source: Summary of retained native AWS CodePipeline S3 deploy captures, not a simulator result

cleanup.proof: Each capture retains DeletePipeline and PipelineNotFoundException, version enumeration and deletion, DeleteBucket and HeadBucket 404, DeleteRolePolicy, DeleteRole and NoSuchEntity.
cleanup.existing_kms_key: Only described and used the pre-existing AWS-managed alias/aws/s3 key; no KMS key was created or modified.

missing_bucket_name.message: Action configuration for action 'Deploy' is missing required configuration 'BucketName'

missing_extract.message: Action configuration for action 'Deploy' is missing required configuration 'Extract'

false_without_object_key.runtime_summary: When the extract feature is disabled, you must provide an object. Edit your pipeline to fix the configuration.

unknown_key.message: Action configuration for action 'Deploy' contains unknown configuration 'Unknown'

admission.content_type_key: Rejected as unknown configuration; ContentType is not a provider configuration key.
admission.empty_extract: ValidationException: configuration map values have minimum length 1.

noncanonical_runtime.message_template_observed_for_True_and_y: Invalid value for configuration property '<value>': 'Extract'. Edit your pipeline and set 'Extract' to either 'true' or 'false'.

extract.explicit_directory_entry: nested/ is present in the input archive but is not deployed as an object.
extract.object_key_prefix: With Extract=true and ObjectKey=prefix/, AWS creates literal prefix//index.html, prefix//nested/config.json, prefix//asset.bin and prefix//README, preserving the doubled slash.

deployment.canned_acl: private; GetObjectAcl retains only owner FULL_CONTROL
deployment.mime_evidence: s3_deploy_native_mime.json: extract/get/*; extension-specific added files all contain identical plain-text bytes, not genuine image/font files.

current_put_object_denied.summary_prefix: You do not have sufficient permissions to call s3.putObject for the deployment bucket,

retry.recovery: Removed the exact-owned role-specific destination bucket PutObject deny, then retried FAILED_ACTIONS in Deploy.

opaque_zip_members.leading_slash: Archive /leading.txt persists as the literal S3 key /leading.txt.

dot_dot_slash.summary: The file name nested/../relative.txt contains invalid sequence: dot-dot-slash.

opaque_zip_members.symlink: Unix symlink-marked nested/link uploads ordinary object bytes ../target.txt; it is neither rejected nor followed.
opaque_zip_members.duplicate: Two duplicate.txt ZIP entries create two S3 object versions; the latest object contains the last entry's bytes: last duplicate\n.
opaque_zip_members.backslash: Archive windows\key.txt is deployed as windows/key.txt.
opaque_zip_members.validation_order: The ordered capture writes leading slash, symlink-marked, both duplicate and backslash entries before the final dot-dot-slash entry fails. This rules out a whole-archive path preflight for these observed cases.

limitations: Noncanonical Extract strings other than True and yes were measured only at admission, not at execution.
No encrypted-ZIP, public ACL, cross-account KMS or archive-size boundary probes.
MIME mapping is limited to the explicitly listed filenames; no host MIME registry or inferred unmeasured extensions.
KMS used an existing symmetric AWS-managed key; no newly created customer-managed key policy behavior was exercised.
